description: This file defines a final class MimeType responsible for managing MIME type mappings based on file extensions. It provides methods to determine MIME types from filenames or extensions, which is useful for content type handling in HTTP responses or file processing within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A utility class for mapping file extensions to MIME types, facilitating content type detection based on filename or extension.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given filename by extracting its extension.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Returns the MIME type associated with a given file extension.
